/bin/bash -lc 'tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
run_case() {
  name="$1"
  shift
  /workspace/dataset/test6_executable "$@" >"$tmpdir/${name}.py.out" 2>"$tmpdir/${name}.py.err"
  py_code=$?
  node /output/test6.mjs "$@" >"$tmpdir/${name}.js.out" 2>"$tmpdir/${name}.js.err"
  js_code=$?
  if [ "$py_code" -ne "$js_code" ]; then
    echo "$name: exit code mismatch py=$py_code js=$js_code"
    diff -u "$tmpdir/${name}.py.out" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.out" || true
    diff -u "$tmpdir/${name}.py.err" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.err" || true
    return
  fi
  if ! cmp -s "$tmpdir/${name}.py.out" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.out"; then
    echo "$name: stdout mismatch"
    diff -u "$tmpdir/${name}.py.out" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.out" || true
    return
  fi
  if ! cmp -s "$tmpdir/${name}.py.err" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.err"; then
    echo "$name: stderr mismatch"
    diff -u "$tmpdir/${name}.py.err" "$tmpdir/${name}.js.err" || true
    return
  fi
  echo "$name: ok"
}
